public.how.title: Mai ka lā kanu a i ka pae ulu
public.how.lead: Hoʻokomo lima ʻia ka pae ulu, no laila pili kona hou i ka hōʻano hope. Ma ʻaneʻi, helu ʻia ia mai ke anilā i hoʻopaʻa ʻia, a mālama ʻia ke kumu o kēlā me kēia loli.

public.step.1.title: E hoʻopaʻa i ka ʻike a ka mahiʻai
public.step.1.body: Mālama ʻia nā mahiʻai, nā mahina ʻai, nā mea kanu, a me nā lā kanu ma Sanity.
public.step.2.title: E kiʻi i ke anilā i hala
public.step.2.body: No ka wahi o ka mahina ʻai, kiʻi ʻia nā ana wela o kēlā me kēia lā mai ka waihona Open-Meteo, mai ka lā kanu a i kēia lā.
public.step.3.title: E hoʻohui i nā lā wela
public.step.3.body: Hoʻohui ʻia nā lā wela ulu (GDD) e like me ke kumu hoʻohālike o ka mea kanu. Ke ʻoi ka huina ma luna o ka palena, hoʻoneʻe ka ʻōnaehana i ke kau kanu i ka pae aʻe a hoʻopaʻa i ke kumu.

public.models.lead: Nā lā wela e pono ai a oʻo ka mea kanu. Ua kākau lima ʻia kēia mau helu, a ʻaʻohe kumu palapala i kēia manawa.
public.live.title: Ke anilā ma ka mahiʻai hoʻāʻo o Swartland
public.live.lead: Nā ana mai nā kumu lehulehu, hōʻano hou ʻia i kēlā me kēia 30 minuke.
public.yields.title: Nā ana hoʻohālike hua ʻohi i paʻi ʻia
public.honesty.title: Pehea e mālama ʻia ai ka ʻikepili
public.honesty.1.title: Na ka mea hoʻohana e hoʻokomo i ka hua ʻohi
public.honesty.1.body: A hiki i ka mea mālama ke hoʻopaʻa i ka hua i ʻohi ʻia, hōʻike ka polokalamu iā “ʻAʻole i hoʻopaʻa ʻia”.
public.honesty.2.title: He moʻolelo kaʻawale nā ana hoʻohālike
public.honesty.2.body: Mālama kaʻawale ʻia nā helu kūloko a me nā helu o ka ʻāina, me ko lākou kumu a me ke ana. ʻAʻole hoʻohālikelike ʻia me ka hua o kekahi māla.
public.honesty.3.title: No ka ʻāina puni nā moʻolelo mea ʻino
public.honesty.3.body: Hōʻike ʻia nā moʻolelo ʻike a GBIF ma loko o 100 km, me ka mamao.
public.honesty.4.title: He ʻike hou ke anilā
public.honesty.4.body: Lawe ʻia nā ana wela mai ka waihona Open-Meteo i ka manawa e noi ʻia ai.

public.open.body: ʻEʻe i ka papa hōʻike hoʻāʻo e ʻike i ke kaha GDD o kekahi kau a me nā ʻike e hōʻoia ana i kona pae.

public.about.title: No Mecropolis
public.about.heading: No Mecropolis
public.about.lead: He polokalamu ʻo Mecropolis no ka mālama ʻana i nā māla a me nā mea kanu o kekahi mahiʻai ma Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Ke kumu o kona hana ʻia
public.about.why.body: Lilo koke ka pae i mea kahiko, a hoʻokomo ʻia ka hua i ʻohi ʻia ma ka hoʻomanaʻo wale nō. Helu ʻo Mecropolis i ka pae mai ke anilā i hoʻopaʻa ʻia. No ka mea mālama a i ʻole kekahi kumu lehulehu i kapa ʻia mai kēlā me kēia helu.
public.about.design.title: Hoʻolālā
public.about.design.1.body: Hoʻohui ʻia nā heat units (GDD) mai ka lā kanu me ka waihona Open-Meteo. Mālama kēlā me kēia loli pae i kona hōʻoia: ka lā i hoʻomaka ai, ka huina GDD, a me ke kumu i helu ʻia ai.
public.about.design.2.lead: Oʻo ma muli o ka wela.
public.about.design.2.body: Kapa ʻia ka pae ma hope o ka wā ma mua o ka ʻohi ʻana he oʻo ma muli o ka wela, no ka mea, ʻaʻohe ʻohi ʻana i hoʻopaʻa ʻia.
public.about.design.3.lead: Na ka mea mālama e hoʻokomo i ka hua i ʻohi ʻia.
public.about.design.4.lead: He ʻike kōkua nā ana hoʻohālike.
public.about.design.4.body: Mālama kaʻawale ʻia lākou me ke kumu, ke ana, a me ka laikini.
public.about.stack.title: Nā lako polokalamu
public.about.stack.body: He polokalamu ʻaoʻao hoʻokahi Vite a me React 19 ma Cloudflare Pages. Heluhelu pololei ka polokalamu kele i ka ʻikepili Sanity lehulehu me GROQ a me kahi mea hoʻolohe manawa maoli. Hele nā kākau a me ka ʻikepili kī ma Cloudflare Pages Functions, nāna e nānā i kahi kuki kau i pūlima ʻia. Hoʻohana ʻia ʻo Zod ma nā palena, ʻo Vitest no nā hoʻāʻo, a ʻo Tailwind 4 no ke kaila.
public.about.limits.title: Nā palena i ʻike ʻia
public.about.limits.1: Ua kākau lima ʻia nā helu o ke kumu hoʻohālike mea kanu (ka wela kumu, nā heat units a hiki i ka ʻōpuʻu ʻana a me ka oʻo ʻana), a ʻaʻohe kumu kuhikuhi i kēia manawa.
public.about.limits.2: No 2000 a 2007 wale nō ke ana hoʻohālike lupin mai HarvestStat, a ʻaʻole i loaʻa i ka holo hoʻomaka kekahi palapala ana hoʻohālike lupin.
public.about.limits.3: He mau moʻolelo ʻike GBIF kokoke i ka mahiʻai ka ʻikepili mea ʻino. Hōʻike lākou i kahi i hoʻopaʻa ʻia ai kekahi ʻano kokoke i ka mahiʻai.
public.about.limits.4: Hoʻokahi ʻeʻe like ko ka hoʻāʻo, a aia ka mea kaupalena noi ma ka hoʻomanaʻo. Hūnā ka ʻeʻe i nā ʻaoʻao papa hōʻike, akā ʻaʻole ia e pale i ka ʻikepili: hiki i ka lehulehu ke heluhelu i ka waihona. Pale nō ia i kēlā me kēia kākau.

docs.stages.title: Ka neʻe ʻana o nā pae
docs.stages.intro: Neʻe mua nā kau ma nā pae ʻeono:
docs.stages.guards: He koi ko kēlā me kēia neʻe. Pono ka pae kanu i ka lā kanu a me ka mea kanu; pono ka pae ulu i ka palena heat units no ka ʻōpuʻu ʻana; pono ka pae ma mua o ka ʻohi ʻana i 90% o ka palena oʻo; pono ka pae oʻo ma muli o ka wela i ka hala ʻana o ka palena oʻo; a pono ka pae nānā i ke kiʻi anilā o ke kau a me kahi ana hoʻohālike i hoʻoholo ʻia. Pono pū nā koi GDD i ka ʻikepili wela no 90% a ʻoi o ka wā, a pāpā ʻia ka neʻe inā aia kona lā hoʻomaka i ka wā e hiki mai ana.

guide.title: Pehea e hoʻohana ai iā Mecropolis
guide.lead: He alakaʻi pōkole ma nā ʻōlelo maʻalahi. Hōʻike ia i ka hana a ka polokalamu, ka poʻe nāna e hoʻohana, a me ka hana a kēlā me kēia māhele.
guide.what.title: He aha ʻo Mecropolis
guide.what.p1: He polokalamu ʻo Mecropolis e mālama i ka ʻike no nā māla a me nā mea kanu. Helu ia i ka ulu ʻana o kēlā me kēia mea kanu ma ka hōʻuluʻulu ʻana i ka mehana mai ke kanu ʻana, a hōʻike pū i ke aniau, ka lepo, a me nā mea ʻino a puni kāu mahiʻai.
guide.what.p2: Ua hana ʻia no nā mahiʻai ma Western Cape, ʻApelika Hema, akā pono nō kēia manaʻo no nā mahiʻai, nā ʻāina, a me nā kau a pau.
guide.who.title: No wai ia
guide.who.p1: No ka mea mālama māla, e like me ka mahiʻai, ka luna mahiʻai, a i ʻole ke kākāʻōlelo kōkua.
guide.who.p2: ʻAʻole pono ʻoe e ʻike i ke kamepiula a i ʻole ka ʻepekema aniau. Inā hiki iā ʻoe ke wehe i kahi kahua pūnaewele, hiki iā ʻoe ke hoʻohana iā Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: No ke aha e hoʻohana ai
guide.why.1: Hiki ke ʻike koke i nā mea kanu i kanu hou ʻia, nā mea e ulu ana, a me nā mea kokoke e mākaukau.
guide.why.2: ʻAʻole pono e hoʻololi lima i kēlā me kēia māla. Na ka polokalamu nō e hoʻoneʻe i ka mea kanu i mua ke hōʻike ke aniau ua hiki ka manawa.
guide.why.3: Hoʻomaopopo ia iā ʻoe no ka hau a me ka wela i nā lā e hiki mai ana, a no nā mea ʻino i ʻike ʻia kokoke i kāu mahiʻai.
guide.why.4: Noho pū nā mea a pau i kākau ʻia no kekahi māla—e like me ka pīpī, kekahi mea ʻino i ʻike ʻia, a i ʻole kekahi memo—me kona lā, i hiki ke nānā hou ma hope.
guide.why.5: Hōʻike kēlā me kēia helu i kona kumu, i ʻike ʻoe i ka mea e hilinaʻi ai.
guide.heat.title: Pehea e ʻike ai ka polokalamu i ka pae o ka mea kanu
guide.heat.p1: Ulu wikiwiki nā mea kanu i ka mehana, a lohi i ke anu. Helu ʻo Mecropolis i kēia mehana i kēlā me kēia lā ma ke ʻano he ana mehana (GDD).
guide.heat.p2: I kēlā me kēia lā, lawe ia i ka waena o ka wela kiʻekiʻe a me ka wela haʻahaʻa, a unuhi i ka wela e pau ai ka ulu ʻana o ka mea kanu. ʻO ke koena ka ana mehana o ia lā. ʻAʻohe mea i hoʻohui ʻia i ka lā anu.
guide.heat.p3: Pono kēlā me kēia mea kanu i kekahi huina ana mehana ma mua o kona mākaukau. Ke hoʻokokoke ka huina mai ke kanu ʻana i kēlā helu, neʻe ka mea kanu i ka pae aʻe.
guide.heat.p4: No Open-Meteo nā ana wela, he lawelawe aniau manuahi e hoʻopaʻa ana i ke aniau o nā wahi a pau o ka honua.
guide.stages.title: Nā pae ʻeono
guide.stages.intro: Hele kēlā me kēia mea kanu ma kēlā me kēia māla ma kēia mau pae, ma kēia kaʻina.
guide.stages.planning: Ua hoʻonohonoho ʻia ke kau, akā ʻaʻole i kanu ʻia ka mea kanu.
guide.stages.growing: Ke hōʻiliʻili nei ka mea kanu i nā ana mehana.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Ua loaʻa ka hapa nui o ka mehana e pono ai ka mea kanu, no laila e hoʻomākaukau no ka ʻohi.
guide.stages.harvested: Ua loaʻa ka mehana a pau e pono ai ka mea kanu, no laila ua mākaukau paha. ʻO ʻoe wale nō ka mea hiki ke hōʻoia ua ʻohi ʻia, no laila kapa ka polokalamu i kēia he oʻo ma muli o ka mehana.
guide.stages.review: Ua pau ke kau, a hiki ke nānā i kona holo ʻana.
guide.stages.p2: Nānā ka polokalamu i kēlā me kēia mea kanu i kēlā me kēia pō, a i kēlā me kēia manawa e hoʻohui ai kekahi i ka mea i ʻike ʻia a i ʻole ka hana mālama. Hiki nō ke kaomi iā Hoʻoponopono i kēia manawa ma kekahi kau no ka nānā koke.
guide.start.title: E hoʻomaka
guide.start.1: Wehe i ka ʻaoʻao mua. Hiki ke ʻike i ka palapala ʻāina aniau, ka lepo, nā mea ʻino, a me nā hua o ka mahiʻai hōʻike me ke komo ʻole.
guide.start.2: Kaomi iā Komo ma luna, a hoʻohana i ka ʻike moʻokāki hōʻike i hāʻawi ʻia iā ʻoe.
guide.start.3: Koho i kekahi mahiʻai. Wehe kēia i ka papa nānā o ia mahiʻai.
guide.start.4: Kaomi i kekahi kau e ʻike i nā mea a pau no kēlā mea kanu ma kēlā māla.
guide.start.5: E hoʻohana i ka pahu ʻōlelo ma luna o kekahi ʻaoʻao e hoʻololi i ka ʻōlelo. Hoʻomanaʻo ka polokalamu i kāu koho no ka manawa aʻe.
guide.home.title: Ka ʻaoʻao mua
guide.home.p1: Hōʻike ka ʻaoʻao mua i ka palapala ʻāina o ka ʻāina, i kala ʻia ma muli o ka nui o ka mehana i loaʻa i ka ʻāina i kēia kau. Hōʻike pū ia i ke aniau o kēia manawa a me nā lā e hiki mai ana, ka lepo ma ka mahiʻai hōʻike, nā mea ʻino i ʻike koke ʻia ma kahi kokoke, a me ka hua awelika o ka ʻāina. ʻAʻole pono e komo no ka ʻike ʻana.
guide.dashboard.title: Ka papa nānā mahiʻai
guide.dashboard.intro: Hōʻike ka papa nānā i hoʻokahi mahiʻai. Eia kona mau māhele mai luna a lalo. Hiki i ka pahu mahiʻai ma luna ke hoʻoneʻe iā ʻoe i kekahi mahiʻai ʻē aʻe.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Hōʻuluʻulu mahiʻai
guide.dashboard.summary: Ka nui o nā māla a me nā ha o ka mahiʻai, ka nui o nā kau e holo nei, a me ka nui o nā mea kanu i mākaukau.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Pono e nānā
guide.dashboard.alerts: Nā ʻōlelo aʻoaʻo pōkole, e like me ka hau a i ʻole ka wela ma ka wānana, kekahi mea kanu i mākaukau, kekahi kau i hoʻomaka ʻole i ka manawa, a i ʻole nā mea ʻino kokoke i kekahi māla. Hōʻike kēlā me kēia ʻōlelo i kona kumu.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Ke kūlana o ka mahiʻai
guide.dashboard.conditions: Ke aniau o kēia lā, ka wānana, ka lepo, a me nā mea ʻino kokoke i kēia mahiʻai.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Ka holo ʻana o ke kau
guide.dashboard.progress: He kāleka no kēlā me kēia mea kanu e hōʻike ana i ka nui o kona mehana i loaʻa. Hiki ke hoʻohālikelike i nā māla, a hoʻoiho i ka papa inoa ma ke ʻano he faila pāpalapala (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Nā māla
guide.dashboard.fields: Nā māla a pau o ka mahiʻai me ko lākou nui, lepo, a me nā mea kanu.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Huli moʻolelo
guide.dashboard.search: Kākau ma nā ʻōlelo maʻamau i kāu mea e ʻimi nei, e like me nā ʻuku mea kanu ma ka palaoa. Loaʻa iā ia nā mea i ʻike ʻia a me nā hana mālama like ke ʻano, ʻoiai he ʻōlelo ʻē aʻe ko lākou.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Nā manaʻo hana
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Nā hana i manaʻo ʻia no kekahi māla, e like me ka pīpī a i ʻole ka mea hoʻomomona. Hiki ke ʻae a hōʻole paha i kēlā me kēia, a kaha ua pau ke hoʻopau ʻia ka hana.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Nā hana hou
guide.dashboard.activity: He papa inoa o ka manawa i neʻe ai kēlā me kēia mea kanu i kekahi pae hou.
guide.season.title: Ka ʻaoʻao kau
guide.season.intro: ʻO ke kau, hoʻokahi mea kanu ma hoʻokahi māla i hoʻokahi makahiki. Aia nā mea a pau nona ma kona ʻaoʻao.
guide.season.top.label: Luna o ka ʻaoʻao
guide.season.top: Ka mea kanu, ka māla, ka lā kanu, ka ʻohi i manaʻo ʻia, a me ka hua ke hoʻokomo ʻoe iā ia.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Nā pae o ke kau
guide.season.pipeline: Nā pae ʻeono me ka pae o kēia manawa i kaha ʻia. Kaomi iā Hoʻoponopono i kēia manawa e nānā koke inā pono ka mea kanu e neʻe i mua.
guide.season.readiness.label: Mākaukau no ka hoʻoholo
guide.season.readiness: He papa kaha o nā mea e pono ai ka polokalamu ma mua o ka hoʻoneʻe ʻana i ka mea kanu, e like me ka lā kanu a me ka lawa o ka ʻike aniau. Hōʻike kēlā me kēia mea iā Holo, ʻŌlelo aʻoaʻo, a i ʻole Paʻa. Inā paʻa, hōʻike ia i ka mea i nele.
guide.season.evidence.label: Nā hōʻike
guide.season.evidence: Nā moʻolelo i hoʻohana ʻia e ka polokalamu no kāna mau hoʻoholo, i hiki iā ʻoe ke nānā.
guide.season.propose.label: Waiho manaʻo hana
guide.season.propose: E manaʻo i kekahi hana no kēia māla me nā hōʻike o ke kau. Noho ia ma ke ʻano he kikoʻī a ʻae kekahi ma ka papa nānā.
guide.season.gdd.label: Nā ana mehana (GDD)
guide.season.gdd: He pakuhi o nā ana mehana e hōʻuluʻulu ana mai ke kanu ʻana, me kahi laina no ka huina e pono ai ka mea kanu.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Pehea inā?
guide.season.whatIf: E hoʻāʻo i ka lā kanu mua a hope paha, a i ʻole ke kau mehana a anu paha, a ʻike i ka loli o nā ana mehana. ʻAʻohe mea e mālama ʻia.
guide.season.summary.label: Hōʻuluʻulu kau
guide.season.summary: He hōʻuluʻulu pōkole o nā moʻolelo o ke kau i kākau ʻia e AI. E hoʻohana ma ke ʻano he kōkua, a nānā i nā moʻolelo ke hewa kekahi mea.
guide.season.notes.label: Nā memo kau
guide.season.notes: Nā memo me ka lā no ke kau. Hiki ke hoʻohui, hoʻololi, a kāpae iā lākou, a hoʻihoʻi i kekahi mana kahiko o ka memo.
guide.season.files.label: Kiʻi māla a me ka hōʻike hoʻāʻo lepo
guide.season.files: Hoʻouka i kekahi kiʻi o ka māla a me ka PDF hoʻāʻo lepo mai ke keʻena hoʻāʻo.
guide.season.log.label: Moʻolelo māla
guide.season.log: Nā mea āu i ʻike ai ma ka māla, a me nā hana āu i hana ai, e like me ka pīpī me kona lāʻau a me ka nui i hoʻohana ʻia.
guide.season.history.label: Moʻolelo hoʻololi
guide.season.history: Nā hoʻololi a pau i mālama ʻia no kēia kau me ko lākou lā.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Ana hoʻohālike o ka ʻāina
guide.season.benchmark: Ka hua awelika o ka ʻāina mai nā helu lehulehu. No ka hoʻohālikelike wale nō ia, ʻaʻole ia ka hua o kāu māla.
guide.season.pests.label: Nā mea ʻino o ka ʻāina
guide.season.pests: Nā mea ʻino i hōʻike ʻia kokoke i ka māla ma GBIF, he waihona lehulehu o nā mea i ʻike ʻia. Kaomi iā Kiʻi i nā ʻike no nā mea hou loa.
guide.sources.title: No hea mai nā helu
guide.sources.weather: No Open-Meteo ke aniau o kēia lā, ka wānana, a me nā lā i hala.
guide.sources.soil: No SoilGrids ka ʻike lepo, he palapala ʻāina lepo o ka honua.
guide.sources.pests: No GBIF nā ʻike mea ʻino, he waihona lehulehu o nā mea i ʻike ʻia.
guide.sources.yields: No USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa, a me ka World Bank nā hua o ka ʻāina.
guide.sources.you: ʻO nā mea ʻē aʻe a pau, e like me nā memo, nā hana mālama, a me kāu mau hua ponoʻī, nā mea āu a i ʻole kāu hui i kākau ai.
guide.limits.title: Nā mea hiki ʻole iā ia
guide.limits.model: ʻO nā ana mehana e pono ai kēlā me kēia mea kanu, he mau koho kuhi na mākou a ʻaʻole i hoʻāʻo ʻia ma ka māla. E hoʻohana ma ke ʻano he alakaʻi, a hilinaʻi i kāu mea e ʻike ai ma kāu māla.
guide.limits.maturity: ʻO ke oʻo ma muli o ka wela, ʻo ia hoʻi ua mākaukau ka mea kanu e like me ke anilā. ʻO ʻoe wale nō ka mea ʻike inā ua oʻo ʻiʻo.
guide.limits.translation: Na AI i kākau i nā unuhi. Maʻalahi paha ke hahai, akā ʻaʻole i nānā ʻia kēlā me kēia ʻōlelo e ka mea ʻōlelo maoli.
guide.limits.demo: Hāmama ka hōʻike hoʻāʻo i nā kānaka a pau. Mai hoʻokomo i kekahi mea pilikino.
